changesets.summary: A multiline ternary is one statement
changesets.details: A ternary spread over lines carries no brackets for the depth table to see, so `group-separation` read its `?` and `:` arms as separate statements and split one — inserting a blank between a condition and its arm that the project's formatter removes. Continuation openers now join the statement above them.

sections.title: Fixes
entries:
- **A multiline ternary is one statement.** A ternary spread over lines carries no brackets for the depth table to see, so `group-separation` read its `?` and `:` arms as separate statements and split one — inserting a blank between a condition and its arm that the project's formatter removes. Continuation openers now join the statement above them.
  _Packages:_ 🟢 _monostyle_, 🟢 _monostyle_rules_
  _Owner:_ Ifiok Jr. · _Introduced in:_ [83d0c3a](https://github.com/ifiokjr/monostyle/commit/83d0c3a36c9583a0dd0ec766e6b471c3f6976f33)
